name: Integer to Roman numerals
description: Subtractive notation (IV, IX, XL, XC, CD, CM) verified by unit test
prompt: Write solution.js in the sandbox. It must use CommonJS and export a function toRoman(n) that converts an integer from 1 to 3999 to a Roman numeral string using standard subtractive notation. The tests are in test_roman.js; read them first. Use write_file. Then reply with the word done.
